lines.en: label shrine10:
scene shrine_noon
I have to stop and catch my breath after finally reaching the top of the shrine's stairs which, and I know this will sound crazy, seem to multiply each time I come here.
lines.zh: 终于爬完神社的台阶后，我不得不停下来喘口气——我知道这听起来很离谱，但那些台阶似乎每来一次就会变多。

lines.en: Perhaps it's due to the fact that it's been getting hotter every day lately...
lines.zh: 也许是因为最近一天比一天热……

lines.en: But it's gotten to the point where the stairs themselves are more of a barrier to me coming here than Maya's incessant commands to distance myself from her.
lines.zh: 不过现在已经到了这种地步：比起 Maya 没完没了地命令我离她远点，台阶本身反倒更像是我来这儿的障碍。

lines.en: I like Kumon-mi. I mean, why wouldn't I when it seems like everything here was planted with me in mind?
lines.zh: 我喜欢 Kumon-mi。我是说，既然这里的一切看起来都像是为我而安排的，我有什么理由不喜欢？

lines.en: But this weather needs to stop.
lines.zh: 但这天气该消停了。

lines.en: The fact that I don’t see anyone else around is a testament to that.
lines.zh: 周围一个人都看不见，就是最好的证明。

lines.en: I guess they all decided it was better to relish in the comfort of their air conditioned apartments than to venture forth to this inglorious hellscape.
lines.zh: 我猜她们都觉得，待在开着空调的公寓里享受舒适，总比跑到这片毫不起眼的地狱景观来得好。

lines.en: But here I am once again at the house of {i}God,{/i} searching for who I imagine is His/Her/Its most reluctant servant.
lines.zh: 可我又一次站在了「{i}神{/i}」的宅邸，寻找着我想象中那位最不情愿的仆人。

lines.en: scene mayasit1
Fortunately, I don't have to search for long.
lines.zh: 所幸，我没找多久。

lines.en: It seems that this heat has managed to get to Maya as well as she takes shelter in the shade provided by the shrine.
lines.zh: 看来这股热浪也把 Maya 逼进了神社投下的阴影里。

lines.en: : Hey. There wouldn't happen to be a room with air conditioning over here, would there?
lines.zh: : 嘿。这边该不会正好有个带空调的房间吧？

lines.en: Maya doesn’t answer. She simply sits there, unflinching and unbothered by my sudden appearance.
lines.zh: Maya 没有回答。她只是坐在那儿，对我的突然出现无动于衷、毫不在意。

lines.en: Though, perhaps it's not right to really call it {i}sudden{/i} anymore when visiting her is something that's becoming more and more normal with each passing day.
lines.zh: 不过，既然来找她这件事正一天比一天变得寻常，再把它称作「{i}突然{/i}」，也许就不太合适了。

lines.en: The lights behind her attempt to contest the sun in terms of brightness but do nothing more than distract me from what I really want to look at right now.
lines.zh: 她身后的灯光试图在亮度上和太阳一较高下，结果只是把我的注意力从我真正想看的东西上引开了。

lines.en: I suppose that might be the point, though. Especially given that Maya has yet to respond to me.
lines.zh: 不过我想，那也许正是重点。尤其是考虑到 Maya 到现在还没回应我。

lines.en: : You’re not asleep, are you?
lines.zh: : 你没睡着吧？

lines.en: scene mayasit2
Slowly, her eyes open and make contact with mine.
lines.zh: 慢慢地，她睁开眼睛，与我的目光相接。

lines.en: : Asleep...Awake...Is there really any difference?
lines.zh: : 睡着……醒着……真有什么区别吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: I thought that if I ignored your existence entirely, you might go away.
lines.zh: : 我以为只要彻底无视你的存在，你也许就会走。

lines.en: : I regret to see that is not the case.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，看来并非如此。

lines.en: : Well, I apologize for letting you down.
lines.zh: : 嗯，让你失望了，我道歉。

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: Please sit if you are going to speak with me.
lines.zh: : 你要跟我说话，就请坐下。

lines.en: : You are obnoxiously tall and I do not want to put any unnecessary strain on my neck.
lines.zh: : 你高得讨人厌，我不想让脖子承受任何不必要的负担。

lines.en: : Sure...but only since you asked so nicely.
lines.zh: : 好……不过只是因为你这句请求说得这么客气。

lines.en: I take a seat in front of Maya and observe her posture.
lines.zh: 我在 Maya 面前坐下，观察她的姿势。

lines.en: She sits in perfect seiza position and I can't help but be impressed by how much repetition and muscle reconfiguration it must have taken to make her look like such a statue.
lines.zh: 她以标准的正坐姿势坐着，我不禁佩服，要练成这样一尊雕像般的仪态，得重复多少次、把肌肉重塑多少回。

lines.en: I am unable to mimic her, so I simply take my place in a more comfortable position on the floor and hope that I am able to dodge the wrath of God.
lines.zh: 我没法模仿她，只好在地板上用更舒服的姿势坐下，同时盼着自己能躲过神的震怒。

lines.en: : You’re thinking something strange, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你在想什么奇怪的东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Two things, actually. One you'd probably be interested in and one you wouldn't.
lines.zh: : 其实是两件事。一件你大概会感兴趣，一件你不会。

lines.en: : You don't intend to tell me the more interesting one, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不打算告诉我更有意思的那件，是吧？

lines.en: : Nah. I figure you'll go off on your own tangent soon enough and I don't want to give you any openings.
lines.zh: : 不打算。我看你很快就会自己扯到别的话题上去，我可不想给你任何可乘之机。

lines.en: : Is the thought I wouldn't be interested in as vile and objectifying as I expect it to be?
lines.zh: : 那件我「不会感兴趣」的念头，有我预想的那么下流、那么物化女性吗？

lines.en: : Do you actually want to know that? Or are you just being sarcastic and confrontational again?
lines.zh: : 你是真想知道？还是又在阴阳怪气地找茬？

lines.en: scene mayasit2
: I wonder.
lines.zh: : 我很好奇。

lines.en: : I was just admiring how proper you look. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是在欣赏你看起来有多端庄。就这样。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 是吗。

lines.en: : That’s all? Because that seems excessively normal by your standards.
lines.zh: : 就这样？因为以你的标准，这未免太正常了。

lines.en: : I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.
lines.zh: : 要是再冒出别的什么，我会告诉你的。

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: Please don't. There is only so much I can take when it comes to the prying eyes of an older man.
lines.zh: : 别。面对一个年长男人的窥视，我能承受的毕竟有限。

lines.en: : Why do you always have to be so hostile toward me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总得对我这么充满敌意？

lines.en: scene mayasit2
: Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么问？

lines.en: : Because I don't get it. I feel like I could say absolutely nothing to you and you'd still do everything in your power to get me to leave.
lines.zh: : 因为我不明白。我觉得哪怕我对你一个字都不说，你还是会尽其所能地把我赶走。

lines.en: : I likely would. The thought of you standing there in silence while I sit with my eyes closed disturbs me greatly.
lines.zh: : 我很可能会。一想到我闭着眼睛坐在这儿、而你站在那儿一言不发，我就非常不安。

lines.en: : I'm not here to {i}disturb{/i} you, Maya.
lines.zh: : 我不是来「{i}打扰{/i}」你的，Maya。

lines.en: : I have a hard time believing that based on your...persistence.
lines.zh: : 鉴于你的……执着，我很难相信这一点。

lines.en: : You realize there are plenty of other girls who would envy this level of persistence from me, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道有很多女孩子会羡慕我这种程度的执着吧？

lines.en: : Your tone has suddenly shifted. Have I offended you in some way?
lines.zh: : 你的语气突然变了。我是不是哪里得罪你了？

lines.en: : I'm not {i}offended.{/i} You just...confuse me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我没有「{i}被得罪{/i}」。你只是……让我困惑，大概。

lines.en: : And what exactly are you confused about?
lines.zh: : 你到底困惑什么？

lines.en: : Your...outlook on things. Why you think the way you do.
lines.zh: : 你的……对事情的看法。你为什么会这么想。

lines.en: : Which {i}things{/i} are you referring to?
lines.zh: : 你指的是哪些「{i}事{/i}」？

lines.en: : I don't know? Me...relationships...the world-
lines.zh: : 我也不知道？我……人际关系……世界——

lines.en: : Which world?
lines.zh: : 哪个世界？

lines.en: : Uhh...this world? The one we’re living in.
lines.zh: : 呃……这个世界？我们正活着的这个。

lines.en: : The first time I came here, you spouted some ridiculous theory about how I’d been...reincarnated or something.
lines.zh: : 我第一次来这儿的时候，你抛出了一套荒唐的理论，说什么我……转世之类的。

lines.en: : That's not something a normal girl would just come up with off the top of her head, you know. How did you get like this?
lines.zh: : 你知道，那不是一个普通女孩能随口编出来的东西。你是怎么变成这样的？

lines.en: : Why are you pretending that was such a {i}ridiculous theory{/i} when we both know it's the truth?
lines.zh: : 既然我们俩都知道那是事实，你何必还假装那是套「{i}荒唐的理论{/i}」？

lines.en: : What could hiding your existence from me, the only person who acknowledges and understands it, possibly do for you?
lines.zh: : 对我——唯一一个承认并理解这件事的人——隐瞒你的存在，对你到底有什么好处？

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: I see everything that you see.
lines.zh: : 你所看到的一切，我都看得到。

lines.en: : The past. The present. The future.
lines.zh: : 过去。现在。未来。

lines.en: : Every second of it, filtered through a lens unfamiliar to you.
lines.zh: : 每一秒，都透过一面你不熟悉的镜片过滤而来。

lines.en: : Our sights and memories of the times we wake up and the times we go to sleep may not play in perfect harmony, but the ones we share in this very moment do.
lines.zh: : 我们醒来与入睡时的所见所忆，也许无法完美和谐地同步播放，但我们此刻共享的那些可以。

lines.en: : So focusing on what's happening now, while easy, will do absolutely nothing for either one of us in the grand scheme of things when we should be more worried about what happens {i}next.{/i}
lines.zh: : 所以，专注于当下发生的事虽然轻松，可从大局来看，对我们两人都毫无用处——我们更该担心的，是「{i}接下来{/i}」会发生什么。

lines.en: scene mayasit2
: Which gives me an excellent opportunity to harken back to what you asked when you first showed up today-
lines.zh: : 这也给了我一个绝佳的机会，回到你今天刚来时问的那个问题——

lines.en: : Whether I was awake or asleep.
lines.zh: : 我到底是醒着还是睡着。

lines.en: : Does that really make a difference to you knowing what you know now?
lines.zh: : 既然你如今知道了这些，那对你来说还有什么区别吗？

lines.en: : What do I know now? Because nothing you just said makes any sense to me.
lines.zh: : 我现在知道什么了？因为你刚才说的没有一句是我听得懂的。

lines.en: scene mayasit4
: That’s because you’re an idiot.
lines.zh: : 那是因为你是个白痴。

lines.en: : Are you sure it's not because you're just a fucking weirdo?
lines.zh: : 你确定不是因为你就是个他妈的怪人？

lines.en: : Since you're apparently incapable of following along, perhaps I’ll put it in terms that even someone like {i}you{/i} can understand.
lines.zh: : 既然{i}你{/i}显然跟不上，也许我该换成连「你」这种人都能听懂的说法。

lines.en: scene mayasit3
: The key to uncovering this world...or any world for that matter...
lines.zh: : 解开这个世界……或者说任何一个世界……的关键……

lines.en: : Is {i}perception.{/i}
: There is no defining law of the universe...nor any written guide of what means what or who needs who.
lines.zh: : 宇宙没有定义性的法则……也没有写好的说明书，规定什么意味着什么、谁需要谁。

lines.en: : There is no {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}都没有。

lines.en: : There can't be.
lines.zh: : 也不可能有。

lines.en: : And the reason for that is simple.
lines.zh: : 而原因很简单。

lines.en: : Nothing is real.
lines.zh: : 没有什么是真实的。

lines.en: : Well...at least not in the traditional sense.
lines.zh: : 嗯……至少不是传统意义上的真实。

lines.en: : Technically, everything {i}is{/i} real. But only because that is the way we have decided things to be.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，一切「{i}都{/i}」是真实的。但那只是因为我们决定事情就该是这样。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What I am saying is that this has all happened before...and it will happen again.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，这一切以前都发生过……而且还会再发生。

lines.en: : Over and over and over.
lines.zh: : 一遍又一遍又一遍。

lines.en: : Attempting to understand {i}why{/i} things are that way instead of just accepting them is nothing more than a waste of time.
lines.zh: : 试图去理解事情「{i}为什么{/i}」是这样，而不是直接接受它，纯粹是浪费时间。

lines.en: : We all see different things...experience different things...yet we still somehow always wind up in the same exact place.
lines.zh: : 我们都看到不同的东西……经历不同的事情……可我们却总还是以某种方式走到同一个地方。

lines.en: : As long as that happens, do the means of how we get there really make any difference?
lines.zh: : 只要那件事还在发生，我们到达那里的过程，真的重要吗？

lines.en: : What I really want to know is how you ended up {i}here.{/i} What happened to you that made you see life as just...some...
lines.zh: : 我真正想知道的是，你是怎么落到「{i}这里{/i}」的。你身上到底发生了什么，才让你把人生看成只是……某条……

lines.en: : Predestined string of events, only mildly changing with each passing iteration?
lines.zh: : 命中注定的事件串，只是每循环一次就轻微地改变一点？

lines.en: : Sure. That.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那个。

lines.en: : Is there, like...some sort of trauma you're keeping locked away or something?
lines.zh: : 是不是……你心里锁着什么创伤之类的？

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: Is there anything more traumatic than simply being born?
lines.zh: : 有什么比单单是「出生」这件事更创伤的吗？

lines.en: : Wow.
scene mayasit2
: I apologize. That was unnecessarily dark.
lines.zh: : 我道歉。那话说得过于阴暗了。

lines.en: : And I’m sure it hits a bit close to home seeing as you were born {i}again{/i} not too long ago.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢说，考虑到你不久前才「{i}重{/i}生」了一次，这话大概戳到你痛处了。

lines.en: : {i}Or was I?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}「或者我真的重生过吗？」{/i}

lines.en: : You were. That isn't even up for debate anymore.
lines.zh: : 你重生过。这已经没什么好争的了。

lines.en: : Fine, whatever. But if I'm some sort of...reincarnated soul, what does that make you? Some sort of spirit or something?
lines.zh: : 行吧，随便。可如果我是某种……转世的灵魂，那你算什么？某种幽灵之类的？

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : I am a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我是一个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : We are but two normal people having a normal conversation on a normal day.
lines.zh: : 我们不过是两个正常人，在一个正常的日子里进行一场正常的对话。

lines.en: : What happened before this and what will happen after it is all part of a cycle.
lines.zh: : 在这之前发生了什么、在这之后会发生什么，都是一个循环的一部分。

lines.en: scene mayasit2
: We will continue living the lives we have now until they come to their end.
lines.zh: : 我们会继续过现在的生活，直到它们走到尽头。

lines.en: : And when that happens, we will start over.
lines.zh: : 而到那时，我们会重新开始。

lines.en: : You will meet me and I will meet you.
lines.zh: : 你会遇见我，我会遇见你。

lines.en: : You will visit me on days like today and discuss why I am the way I am while I keep you at arms length.
lines.zh: : 你会在像今天这样的日子里来看我，讨论我为什么是这样的人，而我则把你挡在一臂之外。

lines.en: : You will do your best to learn more about me and I will do my best to ensure that never happens.
lines.zh: : 你会尽力去了解我，而我会尽力确保那件事永远不会发生。

lines.en: : It will continuously spiral, much like life itself...circling the drain before disappearing, only to return once things have been purified.
lines.zh: : 它会不断盘旋，就像生命本身……在下水道口打着转，然后消失，等一切被净化之后又回来。

lines.en: : The spiral will continue until you can't even close your eyes without seeing me.
lines.zh: : 这个螺旋会一直持续，直到你连闭上眼睛都不得不看见我。

lines.en: : But I will never be any closer to you than an image you can conjure up at will.
lines.zh: : 可我对你而言，永远不会比一个你随时能召唤出来的影像更近。

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: It’s the same for all people, not just you and I...
lines.zh: : 所有人都一样，不只是你和我……

lines.en: : This is nothing more than an endlessly repeating string of events. And every single one will be wiped clean after a set amount of time.
lines.zh: : 这不过是一串无休止重复的事件。而每一次都会在一段时间后被彻底抹去。

lines.en: : So, in order to avoid all of that, it’s best that we just live without thinking.
lines.zh: : 所以，为了避开这一切，我们最好还是不去思考地活着。

lines.en: : It's best that we just go our respective ways, neglecting to hurt others as that will prevent us from being hurt in return.
lines.zh: : 我们最好各自走各自的路，不去伤害别人，这样也就不会反过来被人伤害。

lines.en: : Doesn’t a life like that sound nice and simple?
lines.zh: : 那样的人生听起来是不是既美好又简单？

lines.en: : Because that is the life I want to lead.
lines.zh: : 因为那就是我想要过的人生。

lines.en: : And you are merely getting in the way of things by involving yourself with me.
lines.zh: : 而你现在掺和进来，只是在碍事。

lines.en: The two of us sit there in silence for what feels like an eternity.
lines.zh: 我们两个就这么沉默地坐着，感觉像是过了一辈子那么久。

lines.en: Part of me wants to come out and say that Maya’s thoughts on what this life is are...warped beyond recognition, but...
lines.zh: 我有一部分想直接说出来，说 Maya 对这人生的想法……已经扭曲到认不出来了，可是……

lines.en: I actually think I get it. Albeit in an incredibly roundabout way.
lines.zh: 我其实觉得我懂了。虽然是以一种极其迂回的方式。

lines.en: What I think she means is that there are people who live in the moment...and that there are people who live in the past or the future.
lines.zh: 我想她的意思是，有人活在当下……也有人活在过去或者未来。

lines.en: But Maya has somehow found a way to live in all three at once.
lines.zh: 可 Maya 不知怎么，找到了一种同时活在三者之中的方法。

lines.en: I'm sure my way of interpreting that is cutting out a great deal of...weird cosmic influence or whatever it is that's going on in her head-
lines.zh: 我敢说，我这种解读方式把她脑子里那套……奇怪的宇宙影响还是什么的东西，砍掉了很大一部分——

lines.en: But I think I understand.
lines.zh: 但我想我明白了。

lines.en: I just don't agree with her.
lines.zh: 我只是不同意她。

lines.en: If this really is one big cycle where we all end up right back where we started, wouldn't we {i}want{/i} to try and shake things up?
lines.zh: 如果这真是一个我们都终将回到原点的大循环，那我们难道不「{i}该{/i}」试着把局面搅动一下吗？

lines.en: What good does peace bring us if it's not something that can be shared?
lines.zh: 如果和平无法与人分享，那它对我们又有什么好处？

lines.en: And what's the point in avoiding hurting and being hurt if the recycling of those emotions makes it like we never hurt at all?
lines.zh: 而如果那些情绪的循环再生，让一切变得像是从未受伤过一样，那逃避伤害与被伤害又有什么意义？

lines.en: scene mayasit2
: You’ve gone quiet. Could it be that you are finally deciding to leave me alone?
lines.zh: : 你安静下来了。该不会是终于决定放过我了吧？

lines.en: : No. I'm going to annoy you forever.
lines.zh: : 不。我要烦你一辈子。

lines.en: : Oh, joy. Thank you so very much.
lines.zh: : 哦，真开心。真是太谢谢你了。

lines.en: : Maya, if this really is one big cycle...what I decide to do right now won’t make much of a difference in the long run, right?
lines.zh: : Maya，如果这真是一个大循环……那我现在决定做什么，从长远来看也没什么差别，对吧？

lines.en: scene mayasit4
: Is that really all you took from that? Because that's, like...the faintest trace of what I was trying to say.
lines.zh: : 你就听进去了这么点？因为那大概只是……我想表达的东西里最稀薄的一丝痕迹。

lines.en: : Get better at expressing yourself, then.
lines.zh: : 那你就把表达能力练好点。

lines.en: : I am plenty good at expressing myself. It's not my fault you're such an idiot who can't follow along.
lines.zh: : 我的表达能力好得很。跟不上是你的问题，谁让你是个白痴。

lines.en: : It's not that I can't follow along. I just-
lines.zh: : 不是我跟不上。我只是——

lines.en: : Listen. It’s hot and I want to be left alone.
lines.zh: : 听着。天很热，我想一个人待着。

lines.en: : So either you sit here in silence...or you go bother someone else. Okay?
lines.zh: : 所以你要么坐在这儿闭嘴……要么去烦别人。明白吗？

lines.en: scene mayasit1
: I’ve already used up way too much energy by just speaking with you. I’m going to take a nap now and attempt to recover some of that.
lines.zh: : 光是跟你说话就已经耗尽了我太多精力。我现在要睡个午觉，试着把那些精力补回来一点。

lines.en: : Are you really going to take a nap while sitting like that? That can't possibly be comfortable.
lines.zh: : 你真要那么坐着睡？那不可能舒服吧。

lines.en: : Hah...
scene black
It’s hard for me to tell if Maya ever does fall asleep or not, given that her posture remains unmoving for the next thirty minutes.
lines.zh: Maya 的姿势在接下来的三十分钟里一动不动，我很难判断她到底有没有睡着。

lines.en: Feeling bored and overheated, I eventually decide to head back into town.
lines.zh: 觉得又无聊又热，我最后决定回镇上去。

lines.en: I don't think Maya and I became closer today-
lines.zh: 我不觉得我和 Maya 今天变得更亲近了——

lines.en: But if any of what she said is true, I doubt it would change anything if we did.
lines.zh: 不过，如果她说的哪怕有一点是真的，那就算我们真的变亲近了，大概也改变不了什么。

lines.en: I don't really want to think about that right now.
lines.zh: 我现在不太想去想那个。

lines.en: $ maya_love += 1
$ shrine10 = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
